topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The house stands as it always did, a sentinel of our past, a keeper of our grandmother's whispers. Every creak and groan tells a story only we understand, etched deep in the wood and stone. We walk the halls, my sibling and I, each step a claim, each glance a promise. This isn’t just a place; it’s us, our roots tangled with the foundations, our future rising from the very soil where we once played. The walls hold us, protect us, as they did for generations. There’s a strength here, a legacy to uphold, and together, we are its guardians. The world outside may shift and fade, but here, in our grandmother’s house, we are unshakable.
